transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I guess what finally made me come in is my eating. It’s been really up and down—some weeks I barely touch dinner, and then other nights I’m standing in the kitchen after everyone’s gone to bed eating crackers or sweets. It just feels out of control lately.
When this happens, do you eat an unusually large amount of food in a short period of time?

Sometimes, yes. Not like a huge feast or anything, but there are nights where I’ll stand in the kitchen and keep eating crackers or sweets after everyone’s gone to bed. It feels like more than I meant to eat, and kind of out of control.
After these times when you feel out of control eating, do you make yourself vomit?
No, I don’t make myself throw up after. I just usually feel bad about it and try to go to bed.
After those times when you feel out of control eating, do you do anything to compensate for it, like taking laxatives, fasting, or exercising a lot?
I don’t think so. I mean, I might skip a meal the next day if I feel guilty or just not hungry, but I’m not taking laxatives or doing a bunch of exercise to make up for it.
When you eat like that at night, have you usually woken up from sleep before you start eating?
Not usually, no. It’s more like I’m already up late, and after everyone’s gone to bed I end up in the kitchen eating crackers or sweets. My eating has just been kind of all over the place lately.
When you eat at night, is it usually because you can’t get back to sleep?

Not really because I can’t get back to sleep. It’s more that I’m up late already, and my eating’s been all over the place—some nights I barely eat dinner, and other nights I end up in the kitchen after everyone’s asleep eating crackers or sweets.
Have you been feeling depressed lately?
Yeah… I have. It comes in stretches. The house just feels kind of gray and heavy, and I’ll sit at the kitchen table feeling empty, even if nothing bad actually happened that day.
When you go to the kitchen and eat at night, are you fully awake and aware of what you’re doing?

Yes, I’m awake. I know what I’m doing. It’s more that my eating has been really all over the place—some weeks I barely want dinner, and then other nights I’m standing there after everyone’s asleep eating crackers or sweets.
Do you usually have little or no appetite for breakfast in the morning?

Yeah, usually I don’t have much appetite in the morning. My eating has just been really uneven—some weeks I barely touch dinner, and then other nights I’m up in the kitchen eating crackers or sweets after everyone’s gone to bed.
Do you eat a large part of your daily food after the evening meal?

Sometimes, yeah. Not every night, but there are nights where after dinner I end up back in the kitchen later, eating crackers or sweets after everyone’s gone to bed. Other weeks I barely want dinner at all, so it’s kind of all over the place.
Does this nighttime eating upset you a lot or feel like a serious problem to you?

It does bother me, yeah. I don’t know if I’d call it a serious problem, but it’s part of what made me come in. My eating feels really out of control lately—some weeks I barely eat dinner, and then other nights I’m in the kitchen after everyone’s asleep eating crackers or sweets.
When you eat at night, is it usually a clearly large amount of food for most people to eat in that period of time?

Not usually what I’d call a huge amount. It’s more that my eating is really uneven—some weeks I barely touch dinner, and then other nights I’m standing in the kitchen after everyone’s gone to bed eating crackers or sweets. It feels more out of control than like one really big binge.
When you eat during the night like this, do you feel aware that it's a recurring pattern for you?

Yeah, I’m aware it’s been happening more than just once or twice. It’s not every night, but I can see the pattern—some weeks I barely touch dinner, and then other nights I’m back in the kitchen after everyone’s gone to bed eating crackers or sweets. That back-and-forth is part of what finally made me come in.
On the days this happens, do you eat at least a quarter of your day’s food after the evening meal?

I’m not sure it’s as much as a quarter of the whole day’s food. Some days I barely eat much dinner, and then later I’ll end up in the kitchen eating crackers or sweets after everyone’s asleep. So it can feel like a lot compared to what I ate earlier, but I don’t really measure it.
Do you usually eat more than half of your day’s food after your evening meal?

I don’t think it’s usually more than half. It’s more that my eating is all over the place—some weeks I barely touch dinner, and then other nights I’m standing in the kitchen after everyone’s gone to bed eating crackers or sweets. So it feels out of balance, but I wouldn’t say it’s usually half my whole day’s food.
Do you feel like you eat too much during the evening meal or after supper?

Yeah, sometimes. Not always at dinner itself, but after supper is when it can get out of hand. Some weeks I hardly eat dinner, and then other nights I’m standing in the kitchen after everyone’s gone to bed eating crackers or sweets. That’s part of what made me feel like something’s off.
When you end up eating at night, does it usually happen when you’re feeling especially depressed?

Yeah, it can. When I’m in one of those stretches where everything in the house feels gray and heavy, I’ll end up sitting at the kitchen table feeling empty, even if nothing bad really happened that day. That’s usually when the nighttime eating is more likely to happen.
When you eat at night, is it usually because you can’t get back to sleep unless you eat?

Not usually, no. It’s not like I wake up and can’t sleep unless I eat. It’s more that my eating has been really uneven—some weeks I barely eat dinner, and then other nights I’m just in the kitchen after everyone’s asleep eating crackers or sweets.
When you’re eating at night, do you feel unable to stop or control how much you’re eating?

Yeah… when it happens, it does feel kind of hard to stop. I’ll tell myself I’m just having a few crackers or something sweet, and then I’m still standing there eating after everyone’s gone to bed. It’s not every night, but my eating has been really all over the place.
Do you ever wake up from sleep and then eat during the night?

Sometimes, yeah. Not every night, but there are nights I’m up after everyone’s gone to bed and I end up in the kitchen eating crackers or something sweet. My eating’s just been really all over the place lately.
